question: Mewar festival is celebrated during the _______ festival at Udaipur
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangaur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gangaur** is a festival celebrated predominantly in the Indian state of Rajasthan, particularly in Udaipur.
 
• The festival is dedicated to Goddess Gauri (Parvati) and is celebrated by womenfolk with great enthusiasm and devotion.
 
• It typically occurs in the month of March-April, marking the end of winter and the onset of spring.
 
• During the Gangaur
